BigCommerce has [a suite of APIs](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/quick-start) that let you manage store data, authenticate customers, make client-side queries for product information, and more. API accounts are used to authenticate requests to our APIs.

There are two different API account types that can be created in the control panel: [store-level API accounts](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/api-accounts#store-level-api-accounts) that correspond to a single store, and [account-level API accounts](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/api-accounts#account-level-api-accounts) that function in all stores within your BigCommerce account.

Most apps available in the [App Marketplace](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/How-do-I-access-and-install-the-new-single-click-apps-within-my-Bigcommerce-store-control-panel) are Single-Click apps, which don’t require the added steps of creating a dedicated API account and supplying those credentials to a third party.

### Requirements

- Only the [store owner](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/Store-Owner) can create account-level API accounts.
- To view, create, and manage store-level API accounts, you must be granted [high-risk user permissions](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/User-Permissions) by the store owner.
- To view webhooks, you must be granted the **Read Webhooks**[user permission](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/User-Permissions).

### Creating an API Account

See the list below for instructions that correspond to your desired API account type.

- Store-level API accounts
- Account-level API accounts

#### Store-Level API Accounts

**1.** Go to [**Settings** › **Store-level API accounts**](http://login.bigcommerce.com/deep-links/settings/api-accounts) and click **+ Create API Account**.

A maximum of **50 store-level accounts** can be created per store.

![Create API account button highlighted in the store-level API settings](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/create-api-account.png)

**2.** Select the **Token type**. This will determine whether the new account is a V2/V3 API token or a Stencil-CLI token, which is used in [theme customization](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/storefront/stencil/overview).

![The Token type drop-down with the V2/V3 API token option selected](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/token-type.png)

**3.** Enter a **Name** for the account. The name must be a minimum of four characters long.

![Name field under Create API Account](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/account-name.png)

**4.** For Stencil-CLI tokens, select the access level. For more information on Stencil-CLI tokens, see [Live Previewing a Theme](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/storefront/stencil/cli/development-server) in the Developer Docs.

![Stencil-CLI access levels](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/stencil-cli-access-level.png)

**5.** For V2/V3 API tokens, make a note of the **API path**, you’ll need it to use the API account. If you have provisioned [B2B Edition](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/B2B-Edition) in your store, use the **B2B Edition API path** for B2B Edition APIs.

![The paths for BigCommerce and B2B Edition API requests](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/api-paths.png)

**6.** Under **OAuth Scopes**, specify the API resources and permissions required for your app or integration to access.

We offer a variety of OAuth Scopes for customizing and controlling access to your store's data. For more information, see our [API Documentation](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/api-accounts#oauth-scopes) in the Developer Docs.

![Individual store resources can be set to none, read-only, or modify.](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/oauth-scope-selection.png)

**7.** When you're done making changes, click **Save**. A successful save will display a pop-up window containing the API credentials, and you will be prompted by your browser to download a **.txt file** containing the same credentials for safekeeping on your computer.

**Keep your credentials!** There is no way to return to this pop-up after you dismiss it. Make sure you store your credentials — either by copying and pasting the contents of each field out of the pop-up or by keeping the downloaded .txt. file. For V2/V3 API tokens, we recommend adding the **API Path** value from Step 5 to these credentials, as it is used with the token for all API calls.

#### Account-Level API Accounts

**1.** Go to [**Settings** › **Account-level API accounts**](https://accounts.bigcommerce.com/tokens). You will be redirected from the control panel to the Account-level API accounts page. Click **+ Create Account-level API account**.

![Create API account button highlighted in the Account Dashboard](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/create-account-level-account.png)

**2.** Enter a **Name** for the app or integration corresponding to the API token, then either copy or make a note of the **API path** — you'll need it to use the API account.

![Account-level API account name and path](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/account%20level%20token%20details.png)

**3.** Under **OAuth Scopes**, specify the API resources and permissions required for your app or integration to access. Note that you can select more than one option per resource.

![Account-level OAuth Scopes](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/account-level-oauth-scopes.png)

The following OAuth scopes can be specified in account-level API accounts:

- **Subscriptions** — View or cancel [subscriptions](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/rest/storefront/subscriptions/create-subscription) to your store's marketing and abandoned cart emails.
- **Checkouts** — View or create [storefront checkouts](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/rest/storefront/checkouts).
- **Charges** — Create or delete charges via the [Payments API](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/api-reference/rest/admin/payments).
- **Account** — View account information for Account level [GraphQL](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/storefront/guides/graphql-storefront-api/overview).
- **Account Stores** — View information for stores belonging to the account for Account level GraphQL.
- **Account Apps** — View information for apps belonging to the account for Account level GraphQL.
- **Account Users** — View, Write, or Delete information for users belonging to the account for Account level GraphQL.
**4.** When you're done making changes, click **Save**. A successful save will display a pop-up window with the API credentials, and you will be prompted by your browser to download a **.txt file** containing the same credentials for safekeeping on your computer.

**Keep your credentials!** There is no way to return to this pop-up after you dismiss it. Make sure you store your credentials — either by copying and pasting the contents of each field out of the pop-up or by keeping the downloaded .txt. file. We recommend adding the **API Path** value from Step 2 to these credentials, as it is used with the token for all API calls.

### Deleting an API Account

To delete a Store API account, select **Delete** from the **Action** menu.

- Webhooks associated with the account will also be deleted.
- If you have metafields associated with this account, they’ll be preserved but will be inaccessible when the account is deleted. We recommend deleting any existing metafields before deleting your API account.
- This cannot be undone and you’ll no longer have access to the client ID associated with this account.
![Delete API account highlighted in the Action menu](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/delete.png)

A pop-up window will appear and require confirmation before the account can be deleted. If a webhook is associated with the account, you will need to type the API account name into a field. Once acknowledged and the button is enabled, click **Delete**.

![The Delete API account window, with the field to enter the API account name left blank](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/delete-api-account.png)

### Viewing Webhooks

[Webhooks](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/webhooks/overview) notify applications when specific events occur on a BigCommerce store, including [B2B Edition-related events](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/webhooks/event-reference/b2b-edition). Once you have created a store-level API account, you will be able to view which webhooks are active or inactive on the store, which webhooks are currently blocklisted, and which domains are associated with a store. Note that you **cannot** view webhooks for account-level API accounts.

To view the webhooks associated with an API account, select **Edit** from the **Action** menu.

![Click Edit to view webhooks associated with the API account.](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/edit%20webhook.png)

You will see a list of webhook events, along with the Destination URL, Created date, and Status for each event.

![View webhook event, destination URL, Created date, and status](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/webhooks%20list.png)

**Use BigTools to manage webhooks:** The [BigTools](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/BigTools-Introduction) app provides a simple, browser-based interface for adding, updating, and deleting webhooks without needing to use API calls.

### Notification Settings

To help in managing webhook events, you can set up notification emails to be sent whenever one or more events occur. This allows you to be notified whenever a webhook is deactivated or when a domain is blocklisted, allowing you to respond quickly when any issues arise.

![Notification settings, where you can enter an email for alert notifications.](https://storage.googleapis.com/bigcommerce-production-dev-center/Knowledge%20Base/API/Store%20API%20Accounts/notification-email.png)

Click on the **Notification email** tab, and enter your email address. You can enter multiple email addresses, separated by a comma. When you are ready, click **Save**.

### FAQ

**As an app developer, what authentication options are there?**

Any apps intended for sale on the BigCommerce App Marketplace must use OAuth. OAuth is compatible with all current and planned BigCommerce APIs, including v2 Webhooks and our v3 API. For more information, see our documentation on [Authentication](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/api-accounts) in our Developer Docs.

**Can I create API accounts in my trial store?**

Yes, store owners and users with [high-risk permissions](https://support.bigcommerce.com/articles/en_US/Knowledge/User-Permissions) enabled can create API accounts in trial stores.

**Why am I receiving a "Sorry, there was an error creating your account." message?**

If you are receiving this message when attempting to create an API account, confirm that the **Name** is not already in use by an existing account. Choose a different name and try to create the account again.

**Can I update the OAuth scopes on an existing API account?**

No, existing accounts cannot have their OAuth scopes updated. If you need to change scopes for an existing account, delete the account, then create it again with the desired scopes.

Note that webhooks associated with the account will also be deleted.

**How can I enable a Legacy API account to use an app that requires it?**

Legacy API accounts can no longer be created in the control panel. We recommend reaching out to the app provider about updating their integration to use store-level API accounts.

**If an API account is deleted, can I still modify the webhooks associated with it?**

No. Webhooks associated with an API account will be deleted when the account is deleted.

**How can I tell which API permissions are handled by a particular OAuth Scope?**

Below is a list of all available store-level OAuth Scopes with a summary of each scope's permissions. Keep in mind that some scopes are restricted, such as store logs to read-only. For a list of account-level scopes, see Account-Level API Accounts.

- **Content** — View and modify store content, such as web pages, blog posts, and widgets.
- **Checkout Content** — Read and create scripts on the checkout page.
- **Customers** — Manage customers, customer groups, and wish lists.
- **Customers Login** — Manage customers, log in to customer accounts on the storefront.
- **Information & Settings** — Manage store information, such as store profile contact details, date and time preferences, and default language.
- **Marketing** — View and modify marketing banners, coupon codes, and gift certificates.
- **Orders** — Manage orders and update order statuses.
- **Order Transactions** — View details about the payment instruments used to pay for an order.
- **Create Payments** — Process payment for an order.
- **Get Payment Methods** — Access a list of accepted payment methods for an order.
- **Stored Payment Instruments** — View a customer’s stored payment methods.
- **Products** — View and modify product information, including images, variants and modifiers, categories, brands, and Price Lists.
- **Themes** — Back up, restore, download, and apply themes to the storefront.
- **Carts** — View and create carts on the storefront.
- **Checkouts** — Create checkouts from existing carts on the storefront.
- **Sites & Routes** — Link headless storefronts to sales channels and manage linked pages within the headless storefront.
- **Channel Settings** — View and modify marketplace, POS, and storefront channels connected to your store.
- **Channel Listings** — Manage catalog differences across different storefronts and marketplaces.
- **Storefront API Tokens** — Create tokens used to authenticate cross-origin requests to the GraphQL Storefront API.
- **Storefront API Customer Impersonation Tokens** — Create tokens that allow you to view the GraphQL Storefront API as a specific customer.
- **Store Logs** — View store logs of staff activity and system events.
- **Store Locations** — Create and manage inventory locations for your store.
- **Store Inventory** — Track and update inventory across multiple locations.
- **Fulfillment Methods** — Manage the pickup methods available for each location.
- **Order Fulfillment** — View and create order pickup events.
- **Metafield Ownership** — Manage which API accounts own metafields.
- **Metafield Access** — Create and manage metafields belonging to the API account making the request.
- **B2B Edition** (*B2B Edition stores only*) — Manage all B2B Edition v3 REST Management APIs.
**Why can’t I find some of my B2B API accounts?**

Previously, you were required to create B2B tokens in B2B Edition’s [API Account Settings](/articles/en_US/Knowledge/B2B-Edition-Settings). Go to **Settings** › **API Accounts** in the B2B Edition control panel to view and delete previous v3 B2B tokens, or to refresh legacy v2 B2B tokens. Note that these settings are hidden on stores that do not have any legacy B2B-only API tokens.
